rules.statement: A party who advances money on an informal agreement void under section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 is entitled to a refund only if he is not the party in default.
rules.supporting_quote: "The law on the subject is clear, and has been settled by the case Nagoor Pitche v. Usoof.[1] It was there decided that a party who advances money on an informal agreement void under section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 is entitled to a refund only if he is not the party in default."
